programme.sub-title: Things That Go Bump In The Night

Barnaby and Scott start looking into a spiritualist church in the village that had been heavily controversial. Elizabeth, a friend of Joyce, who had attended their meetings, tells her that she was suspicious of both the spiritualist church and the undertaker and believed they were acquiring information and stealing from the dead.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Down at the Midsomer Regatta, the day is interrupted by the body of Guy Sweetman, Chairman of the local rowing club, resurfacing midway through a race. Barnaby and Scott learn that Guy was a ladies' man with many past conquests. He had been in secret meetings with a few other members. The two detectives uncover lies, blackmail, jealousy and a planned robbery, before the latest woman Guy was planning to marry is attacked and almost killed.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When a local handyman finds a female classics teacher and a member of a group of orchid enthusiasts poisoned in her own home, DCI Barnaby finds himself heading back to Midsomer Malham, the day after he and Joyce had helped out during the village's annual garden show. It is discovered that the victim had a secret lover and had helped to smuggle a rare one-of-a-kind orchid, the Yellow Roth, out of Borneo.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A successful day at the races for the racehorse, Bantling Boy, the previous day, it is not long before one of the horses' owners is found murdered in the horses' stables. The victim, Bruce Hartley, had been in dispute with the other owners of Bantling Boy, the night before his murder had had a rather heated argument with them and had refused to let them acceptance of an offer to buy the horse. It seems to make things a whole lot worse of the others in the syndicate.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: John Ransom gets thrown out of the village pub in Midsomer Mere, for fighting with his brother-in-law, and a short while later he is found dead on the green. It is discovered that John had been used as a guinea pig for scientific experiments by his brother Max, who suspected he had the ability of 'Second Sight'. Barnaby and Scott soon discover that another family possesses the same talent. They have to delve deeper to unravel many secrets within the village to find the truth.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When solicitor Nick Turner apparently commits suicide by walking off the roof of his home in Midsomer Magna, then Nick's neighbour Jack Wilmot mysteriously disappears that same day, it starts a series of unexplained events. Barnaby and Scott soon discover that a large amount of money has gone missing from the account of one of Nick's clients. Shortly afterwards, Nick's rival gets murdered in an elaborate ritual, by his own model of a medieval catapult, while his wife is forced to watch.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The body of a visitor is found on-site at the famous relish factory of Plummer & Son in the village of Little Upton. It is not long before legal documents, family resentments and mysterious sightings add to the complexity of the case.

programme.title: Return Of Sabata

But as Wilson and his gang flee the scene, there's one important detail they've overlooked…Cooper is still alive! Saved by a sheriff, Cooper takes on the job of deputy marshal to bring justice to the Oklahoma territory…and to the nine men who "done him wrong."

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: In the world of 2055, men are extinct. Preserved by cryonics, a man (David Keith) awakens in Lithia, a poor matriarchy. He’s welcomed, but when he upsets the natural order of things, the question arises: Can the world men be revived? And should it?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When two archeologists (Lisa Zane, David Cubitt) discover a cocooned alien that suddenly begins to reanimate, the rest of the research team turns greedy, wanting to cash in on it. When the couple refuses, they find themselves numbered...or are they?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An alien (Rene Auberjonois) and his family live on a secure farm on Earth, where they grow their own food. Most of the aliens believe that the human race was wiped out in the war, but there is a group of humans in the woods...and they are starving!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A doctor (Maurice Godin) creates a controversial process to reverse aging and disease. So, when an older woman (Barbara Rush) he loves is close to death, he knows he can save her. But there is always a price to be paid...in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: On Mars, the Free Alliance and the Coalition of Middle-Eastern and Pacific States mine minerals under a truce until an apparent attack on Earth. Without clear evidence of war, is retaliation wise, or hasty? Barbara Eve Harris and Adam Baldwin star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A former soldier (Ron Perlman) has horrifying flashbacks from his days as a member of a covert branch of the military. But when flashback star to become reality, he wonders whether he is insane...or if there a new covert mission afoot.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Mac 27 (Nicolas Lea) is Innobotics' newest android. He’s emotionless, but he escapes after a glitch and takes a hostage, Celia (Nana Visitor). She sees human qualities in Mac and tries to convince him that he has feelings. But why help her captor?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Joe Pantoliano stars as a shock-jock whose specialty is ridiculing UFO believers. But when a true Believer sets himself on fire in front of Stan, the D.J. finds the very foundation of his disbelief beginning to crumble. Cynthia Nixon also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a cancer-ridden doctor (Robert Hayes) is given a full-body transplant, he soon develops disturbing visions of a life he never led, of loves he's never experienced... and of a shocking, brutal murder. Wendel Meldrum and Thomas Cavanaugh also star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A brilliant inventor (Ralph Waite) who murdered a man who stole credit for his work, is double crossed by the other inmates in jail when they discover his "small friends" -- microscopic machines --can seve just about any purposeï¿½including jailbreak.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The Grell had come to earth not as equals, but as slaves. Now, an uprising has gripped the world in fear, and a high-ranking government official (Ted Shackelford), who is lost in Grell territory, experiences firsthand the ugly face of racism.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Dr. Eberhardt (Ralph Macchio) discovers a way for comatose patients to communicate with each other by interfacing with a computer. But when he hooks himself up to the machine, he discovers a cyberspace "paradise" he may never be able to leave!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Cliff Robertson -- who starred in the very first episode of the classic series -- returns to the Outer Limits as an aging astronaut whose 1963 mission was a career-ending disaster. If he can just get back to space, perhaps he can clear his name.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Like other Star Fleet vessels, Ship (voice of Malcolm McDowell) has evolved and now controls the only human (Jack Noseworthy) aboard. But the relationship takes a dramatic turn when Man meets Woman and fights machine in a desperate bid for freedom!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Do our memories define our identity? If we are merely the sum of our experiences, what do we become if those experiences are lost? Hope Wilson (Robbie Chong) faces this question when she meets a man who has purposely erased his own memories.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Courtesy of a freak accident (and The Outer Limits), an agoraphobe (Jane Adams) begins to hear the private thoughts of all of the tenants in her building...the good, the bad and the steamy. And it seems at least one of them may want to kill her.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A scientist -- who is also a religious zealot (David Ogden Stiers) -- secretly implants an embryo created with DNA from the Shroud of Turin into a young woman (Samantha Mathis) in order to scientifically engineer the Second Coming of Christ.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The Outer Limits come to Victorian Whitechapel when a London doctor (Cary Elwes) races to capture the alien creature responsible for the Jack the Ripper murders. But when the alien frames the good doctor for the murders, his time may be up.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The son (Saul Rubinek) of a concentration camp survivor (Peter Boretski) gets some unique help in proving the guilt of a former Nazi (Jan Rubes) living in the U.S....courtesy of a time traveler (Alex Daikun) and, of course, The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The planets Earth and Dregocia struggle to re-establish a fragile trust after a summit goes tragically wrong. Can a diplomat (Marcia Cross) calm the hawkish nature of both species…and can she overcome her own prejudices to save both worlds?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A meek anthropologist (Leland Orser) develops a serum for genetic dominance and tests it on himself. Now his newfound confidence takes complete control of him, turning him into an irrational, overly aggressive troglodyte! Can he reverse the process?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The Haven is a high-tech apartment building which is run by supercomputer and almost completely eliminates the need for human contact. But when things begin to go wrong, neighbors who have never met must learn to work together in order to survive!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a scientist's (Kevin Nealon) experiment unintentionally creates a rift in the space-time continuum, he suddenly find himself caught in a time loop and soon begins to suspects sabotage. Terri Hawkes, Jennifer Copping and Ronny Cox also star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A boy (Adam Hann-Byrd) , picked on by high-school bullies and neglected by his own father (Daniel Hugh Kelley), finds comfort in an alien (Chris Potter) who has crash-landed on earth. But is the alien what he claims to be? Never…in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: In a world dominated by alien invaders, a cynical American cafe owner (Nathan Fillion) must decide if he will risk his life to help an old lover fight for Earth or if he is happy not rocking the political boat. Derek de Lint also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When Detective Terry Russo (Megan Gallagher) is called to investigate a double murder, she discovers she may be solving not one crime, but possibly hundreds. And that the culprit -- or culprits -- may not be human at all. Michael Riley also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: How can you change a racist's thinking? How can someone who has had a racist viewpoint his entire life learn to accept a biracial granddaughter? Catch up on Charlie's story.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Phyllis and Barry say they're desperate to calm their violent 15-year-old son, Brandon, and turn to Dr. Phil for help. Their requests for Brandon to perform simple tasks such as brushing his teeth or bathing cause him to go into a rage, breaking things and punching holes in walls, and even chasing Phyllis with scissors. Barry says they walk on eggshells, waiting for Brandon’s next violent outburst and that every day he leaves the house worried that his wife may not be alive when he returns. What is at the root of Brandon's anger? Dr. Phil spends some one-on-one time with the young man to determine what’s driving his behavior. And, find out what Phyllis recently found in Brandon’s room that shocked her to her core.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The conversation about the rise in mental health issues among young people continues. Dr. Phil speaks with 22-year-old Emma, who says she was a cheerleader and “picture-perfect American girl” who appeared happy on the outside but was secretly struggling with severe anxiety and depression, which led her to make a near-fatal decision that changed her life forever. Ross Szabo, the wellness director at Geffen Academy at UCLA, the CEO of the Human Power Project, and co-author with Melanie Hall of Behind Happy Faces: Taking Charge of Your Mental Health, says he has ideas to implement more mental health education in schools. And, Massachusetts's Congressman Seth Moulton shares his latest project: the new 9-8-8 National Suicide Prevention Lifeline. Americans experiencing a mental health crisis or who are concerned about the mental health of a loved one are now able to dial 9-8-8 and get rapid, free, trained and confidential help from a network of 200+ local crisis centers nationwide.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Marilyn says she’s fed up with her son-in-law Adam, whom she calls “irresponsible,” “hot-tempered,” “verbally-abusive,” “entitled,” and a “cheater.” She says she’s tired of what she calls Adam’s disrespectful attitude toward her and her daughter, Miranda, and claims that his reckless spending and inability to take care of his family make him a “poor excuse for a husband.” Adam denies her accusations and says he’s a good dad and provider for his family. What does Miranda say? Can Dr. Phil help heal this fractured family?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The truth behind a toxic relationship between a student and professor.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part 2 of Dr. Phil’s exclusive interview with Gabby Petito’s parents, who are all sitting down together for the first time, they share where they believe Brian Laundrie may be hiding, and what they hope happens to him if he was involved in Gabby’s death. Plus, see their reaction to the latest developments in their daughter’s case.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Change My Face, Change My Race
programme.desc: Most everyone has thought about removing imperfections: a nip here, a tuck there. But what about people who want plastic surgery to erase their ethnic identity? Dr. Phil gives his take on divisive racial issues.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A woman says her daughter has a history of drug abuse, and she fears that her grandchildren are being neglected.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Is Mom Leading a Secret Life?
programme.desc: Brandy, 24, and Jacki, 27, say they believe their mother, Kimberly, is leading an X-rated secret sex life, while maintaining the façade of a happy marriage of 29 years to their stepfather. Kimberly says her daughters are stirring up drama with half-truths and misinformation and need to butt out of her business. Can Dr. Phil get to the truth — and help put this family back together?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: They’re self-absorbed, spoiled and entitled brats, otherwise known as Generation Me. MTV correspondent Kim Stolz recently hit the streets of New York to find out how the younger generation feels about this label. Don't miss the candid responses. Then, Bradley, 24, says he wants to be rich and drive a Lamborghini, but he only wants to put in 80 percent of the effort. He still relies on his mom, Christine, to pay his rent and other bills. Will Bradley learn to stand on his own two feet? Plus, Monica says her 18-year-old daughter, Courtney, is an “entitlement princess,” and she gives the teen money just to keep the peace. Will mom and daughter get a wake-up call? And Jean Twenge, author of Generation Me, reveals why many young people are narcissistic.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The saga of a father's quest for his vanished daughter is discussed.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his interview with Tommy, who accuses his ex-wife, Julia, and her new husband, Codey, of killing his 19-month-old son, Darby, and 4-year-old stepdaughter, Kiera -- an allegation the couple vehemently deny. Dr. Phil enlists the help of forensic pathologist Dr. Cyril Wecht to examine the children’s autopsy reports -- what are his findings? And, will Julia and Codey agree to take polygraph tests?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A woman recounts her marriage to a man, who allegedly concealed his criminal past.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Sunny was enraged when she learned her mom, Carolyn, was adopting Sunny’s 36-year-old ex-boyfriend, Chris, and begged her to not go through with the process. Now that the adoption is final, she says Carolyn puts more time and energy into her relationship with Chris than into their mother-daughter bond. Carolyn says she always wanted a son and was over-the-moon when she finally adopted Chris. She says no parent has to ask their child for permission to have more children, so why should she need Sunny’s approval to adopt Chris? Carolyn and Sunny see each other for the first time in more than six months on Dr. Phil’s stage. Can Sunny move past her feelings of betrayal, and can Dr. Phil help them mend their broken bond? Then, why did Chris, a married father of three, want to be adopted?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In-laws can be the kind who give unwanted advice, stop by unexpectedly and use guilt and manipulation to get what they want. But sometimes, they are loving parents who get caught in the middle of their child's relationship. Amanda calls her mother-in-law, Yolande, psychotic, controlling and meddling. She says Yolande speaks to her son, Pierre, in French so she can hide the hurtful words she’s using about Amanda. Yolande says Amanda is a drunk, and an uneducated woman who is wrecking her son's life. Why does Pierre say he can't choose a side? To test Amanda's theory of why Yolande and Pierre speak French to each other, Dr. Phil sets up a "special" dinner for the three of them. Be a fly on the wall, and find out if Amanda's right or just being paranoid. And, John and Chrissy's engagement is on hold because they say they can't stop fighting. They hit and slap each other, and call each other vulgar names — often in front of their 8-month-old son. John's mom, Charlene, who is often pulled into their fights, says they both need to grow up! After watching themselves scream and yell on tape, will this couple decide to drop their fists, close their mouths and work to make a peaceful home for their baby?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Parents: How well do you know your teen? Could your daughter be indulging in harmful activities right beneath your nose? Anna says she was outraged when she discovered her daughter, Allie’s, secret addiction to prescription pills. Allie maintains that she’s been clean for four months, but Anna doesn’t believe her. She says the 19-year-old has been involved in three car accidents in the past seven months, and the police recently brought her home for erratic driving. Does Allie still have a problem with prescription meds? Will she agree to take a drug test? Then, 17 year-old Elizabeth wrote in to the Teen Talk forum because she says she’s leading a double life. She says her secret is eating her up inside, and she wants to confess to her parents. Find out what the young woman’s been hiding, and see how her folks respond when she drops the bombshell.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A woman says her husband has falsely accused her of infidelity.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Alan says he's being falsely accused of a heinous crime, and his accuser is his own mother-in-law! She claims he molested his 3-year-old daughter. Who's telling the truth? Find out when Dr. Phil reads the results of Alan's polygraph exam. Can this family heal and move on?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Amanda says her husband of two years, Jeffrey, was recently caught in an online child sex sting and sentenced to five years in prison, yet she’s not sure if she should leave him. Why does she say she blames herself for what happened? And, hear from Amanda’s parents, Juliet and Timothy, who say they just want their daughter to move on. When Dr. Phil gives Amanda a harsh dose of reality, will she see the situation for what it is? Then, 18-year-old Seri says that two years ago, she fell in love with 26-year-old Hector, who convinced her to quit school and become a prostitute — and give him all the profits. Hector was convicted of sexual assault of a child and is now serving up to 30 years in prison. Seri is raising their daughter and has a new boyfriend, Will, but she admits that she would consider taking Hector back, if given the opportunity. Why does Seri say she still has feelings for her abuser?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil investigates what he believes is a problematic phenomenon in our society: Cancel Culture: the way a large group of people can turn on and seek to dismantle the character, career, and sometimes life, of a person who says or does something that doesn't align with the group world view. Dr. Phil welcomes DailyMail.com editor-at-large Piers Morgan, whose new book Wake Up examines this very topic. Dr. Phil also invites Antifa member Daryle, and housewife turned activist Gina, who believes cancel culture is sometimes the only way to bring bigoted people to justice. Watch while Dr. Phil weighs in on this fierce debate!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Linda and Rich say their three 20-something daughters are all hooked on heroin -- and the parents disagree about how to handle the situation. Linda admits she enables her daughters by giving them money, paying their bills and providing a place to stay, but she says she just can’t kick them out -- like Rich wants to do. Dr. Phil gives the couple an uncensored look at a day in their daughters’ lives -- obtaining money at any cost, buying drugs and shooting up together. Will this be the eye-opener the parents need to stop enabling their daughters and help save their lives? And, will the siblings accept help under Dr. Phil’s one big, non-negotiable condition?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Brenda says she fell in love with and married her husband, Don – despite their 26-year age gap. But soon after, she claims her “Prince Charming” turned “crazy” and “temperamental.” Is their age difference at the root of their issues? Then, Bev says she’s concerned for her sister, Melanie, who married her much younger man, Devar, after meeting him on a Jamaican vacation. Is Devar in it for love, or for a green card and money? And, Dr. Phil catches up with best-selling author Mitch Albom.

Lexxy forms a female hip hop group, with dreams of breaking into the industry. Things look promising until lies and betrayal break up the group, and dissolve all friendships.

programme.title: Germany in Ruins
programme.desc: March 6, 1945. Cologne is the first major German city to fall to the Allies. Stalin plans to conquer Berlin before the other Allies arrive.

programme.title: Downfall and Liberation
programme.desc: April 16, 1945. The Red Army begins its offensive on Berlin. The first concentration camps have been liberated by British and US forces, who discovered emaciated prisoners and corpses.

programme.title: Signs of Evil - The Runes of the SS
programme.desc: The symbol of the SS, Hitler’s Schutzstaffel, stands for terror and the murder of millions. The penniless graphic artist Walter Heck was given the job of designing the jagged, rune-like characters in 1929. The “sig” rune was rooted deep in the ideological cosmos of the Nazis and their supporters. They saw themselves as the descendants of the Teutons and declared the runes to be humanity’s original Germanic script. The symbol was meant to unite Heinrich Himmler’s “Black Order.” But did it escape their notice that it was originally of Semitic origin? In October 1945, the Allies passed a law banning the Nazi Party and all associated organizations, including the SS. The young Federal Republic even forbade all Nazi symbols. This documentary tells the gripping story of the SS symbol, from the Middle Ages to the present day.

programme.title: The War continues

programme.title: Gold for Kim - A Life for North Korea's Leader
programme.desc: North Korea is a country of stark contrasts. On the one hand, it presents real socialist stereotypes like cryptic messages from a frozen time loop, combined with shocking reports on shortages. On the other hand, polished Pyongyang lures with a futuristic skyline, flashy amusement parks and department stores with a range of goods equal to those in western consumer meccas.

programme.title: Mata Hari - The Beautiful Spy
programme.desc: In February 1917 World War I is raging when Mata Hari is arrested in Paris and taken to the examining magistrate. Her very life is at stake: she is accused of high treason. The famous exotic dancer has come to represent beauty and the power of feminine seduction. The documentary Mata Hari - the Beautiful Spy tracks down the true story of this fascinating woman.

programme.title: Osama Bin Laden - Up Close and Personal
programme.desc: Just after midnight on May 2, 2011, United States Special Forces raided the compound in Abbottabad, Pakistan, where Osama Bin laden had been hiding for years. “America’s public enemy number one” was killed during the operation. The Navy SEALs thoroughly searched his house, recovering everything that could provide information about Bin Laden and his terrorist network Al-Qaeda: His documents and private correspondence, as well as every electronic data carrier.

programme.title: The Child Crusades - Barefoot to the Promised Land
programme.desc: In Cologne in 1212 a boy named Nicholas captivated thousands of children between the ages of eight and fifteen with his fanatical speeches. They had been chosen, he said, to liberate Jerusalem. Likewise, in the French town of Cloyes a young shepherd gathered numerous children around him with the same proclamation.

programme.title: Forest of Heroes
programme.desc: From Lower Saxony and North Rhine Westphalia, from Osnabrück to Paderborn, one of Germany’s most beautiful forests extends for some 150 kilometers - the Teutoburg Forest. The low mountain range became famous due to the Varus Battle that took place in 9 AD. It was here that Hermann, or Arminius, the Cherusci Prince vanquished the Roman occupation army.

programme.title: The Battle for the Baltic Sea
programme.desc: It’s in spring 2008, when the telephone of the Archaeological State Office Schleswig-Holstein suddenly rings. The message archeologist Martin Segschneider receives makes him curious.

programme.title: Operation Peter Pan - The Secret War against Cuba
programme.desc: In 2016, a historic moment arrived when Barack Obama spoke in Cuba to the inhabitants of the island nation and promised a future together. For the first time in more than 50 years, an American president had entered the communist country and turned towards an erstwhile enemy. However, the US economic embargo against Cuba continues. It sanctions the socialist state – although the UN General Assembly recently again called it a violation of international law. Many Cubans are therefore sceptical about a new political future, despite the friendly words of the American President. Their distrust is deep. It is based on over fifty years of history and the policies of the United States towards their country. For years, the Cuban government has raised serious allegations against their big neighbour. The film "Operation Peter Pan" tracks these allegations.

programme.title: Monsters and Myths
programme.desc: Monsters have always been part of our nightmares and fairy tales. But where do they actually come from? How much of them is truth, how much is myth? Going to great lengths in this documentary, the filmmakers join scientists to explore a number of the best known sagas and legends in the world.

programme.title: World War A - When Aliens Attack
programme.desc: Scientists are already looking feverishly for evidence of extraterrestrial life. With the ExoMars mission, ESA will soon find life on Mars. If there are only tiny microbes, there could also be life in other places in the universe. But can life in space exist at all? The exobiologist Jean-Pierre de Vera collects microorganisms around the world and tests them in his Mars simulation laboratory. Can they survive under the deadly conditions of Mars? Researchers believe there are planets on which alien life can exist. In 1991 the Swiss astrophysicist Michel Mayor discovered the world's first exoplanet. Since then, about 3,000 planets have been detected outside our solar system. Heike Rauer from the German Aerospace Center is looking for habitable planets. Will she find a second earth? The European Southern Observatory is also searching for life in space, building the largest telescope in the world. In the next 20 years the E-ELT should be able to prove the existence of life on distant planets. How would extraterrestrials look? Some scientists suspect that they may well resemble us humans. Under other environmental conditions, alien life could also arise completely differently. It could be formed from methane and silicon. Different gravity would form alien bodies completely differently. Could extraterrestrials send us messages? At the SETI Institute in California, alien hunters like Seth Shostak are listening to signals from alien civilizations. But mere listening is no longer enough. Some SETI researchers now want to send messages to the aliens themselves. They hope to finally get an answer. But would that be a bad idea? Many scientists warn of the dangers of establishing contact. The former SETI researcher and science fiction author David Brin also fears that it could be a devastating mistake. With well-meant news we could end up attracting attention from hostile civilizations. Should we really tell them that we exist and where they can find us?

programme.title: UFOs and the Cold War
programme.desc: Pop culture is unthinkable without them, and so is the Cold War: UFO’s, those flying saucers allegedly bringing aliens to dominate the world.

programme.title: The Balkans in Flames

programme.title: Hannibal: A March on Rome

programme.title: Crime Scene Eulau - The Mystery of the 13 Skeletons
programme.desc: This documentary focuses on a spectacular discovery made in a quarry near the village of Eulau, not far from the central German town of Naumburg. Neolithic graves contained the skeletons of three women, two men and eight children, buried tenderly 4500 years ago, some affectionately entwined. In 2008, for the first time anywhere in the world, it was possible to perform a DNA analysis on the earliest evidence of the existence of a nuclear family. This was a sensation - but why did these people all die at the same time? Were they the victims of a violent crime? Who were they, and how did this terrible drama unfold? Archaeologists insist that these victims will not be forgotten, since these days it is possible to do far more than simply date and record such finds. Modern scientific methods have revolutionised archaeology, enabling us to discover how and why the family from Eulau in the German state of Sachsen-Anhalt died 4500 years ago. By enlisting the help of a CID profiler, archaeologists and anthropologists employ state-of-the-art analytical methods to investigate this Stone Age crime. In the process we discover key information about an era before recorded history which has previously been shrouded in mystery - and astonishing information about the composition of the population here also comes to light. It seems that the third millennium before Christ saw two major waves of migration, from Eastern and Western Europe, which determine the composition of the population here. In the middle of what is now Germany these two migratory movements met. Could this be the background to the mysterious murders of Eulau?

programme.desc: Welcome to Artists's Academy where we are dedicated to making you a better artist. We believe everyone has an artist within, waiting to be unleashed. programme.title: Woodworkers Guild of America presented by CraftsyTV
programme.sub-title: Nature-Inspired Crafts: Wooden Rope Seat & Slab Wood Coffee Table
programme.desc: In the episode "Easy Projects with Native Materials," the focus is on crafting robust furniture using natural materials, bringing joy to woodworking enthusiasts. The project kicks off with a stool build using one-inch dowels for rails and sturdy legs crafted from one-and-a-half-inch square pieces. A standout feature is the woven seat, initially demonstrated with bundling twine but showcased with Cecil rope for its natural charm and durability. The construction process begins meticulously, drilling precise holes using a drill press for consistent alignment. Offset holes on adjacent faces accommodate the rails snugly, while chamfered ends prevent any interference during assembly. Dry-fitting ensures all components fit seamlessly before applying glue, guaranteeing a sturdy final product. After assembly, the stool is clamped securely to maintain square alignment and left to dry before sanding and finishing bring out the wood's natural beauty. The seat weaving process is a highlight, with the speaker demonstrating how to wrap Cecil rope around the frame in a precise pattern, creating a durable and visually appealing seat. Throughout, the importance of precision and the handy use of pliers for control during weaving are emphasized. The episode also explores comparisons between stools made from different materials, celebrating the diversity of woodworking choices. Transitioning to a coffee table project, the speaker selects wood pieces with a striking blue stain for added visual interest. Techniques for drilling and joint fitting are expertly demonstrated, ensuring the table frame is not just sturdy but also artistically crafted. Challenges encountered, such as uneven surfaces or knots in the tabletop, are met with practical solutions, including finishing tips with Danish oil for a natural, lustrous look. Throughout the tutorial, the joy of working with native materials and the satisfaction of creating beautiful, enduring furniture pieces shine through, making it a delightful watch for woodworking enthusiasts of all skill levels.

programme.title: Peak Performance - CliffPrince

Prince found a magical spot where the fishing was on fire the first two hours of every tournament day and it lasted all four days en route to his first blue trophy on the Bassmaster Elite Series. The area was 4 to 5 feet deep and Prince maintained a low profile and fished his chatterbait around grass and over a hard spot without using his forward facing sonar.

programme.desc: Chris Smeltzer's journey into MMA began 12 years ago, through Karate. Chris' work as a School Bus driver fits perfectly with his MMA lifestyle, allowing him the flexibility to train throughout the day, as well run a karate school for kids. The martial artist lifestyle helped bring structure to all areas of Chris' life. He believes he has become a better person through Martial Arts, and he makes the mental distinction between between being a fighter and being Martial Artist. He prefers the standup game feels he is progressing well to being an all around fighter with his BJJ Blue Belt.

programme.title: Commando 3
programme.desc: Commando 3 is an action-packed thriller that follows Karanveer Singh Dogra (played by Vidyut Jammwal), an elite Indian commando, who is sent on a mission to London to track down and eliminate a terrorist threat. As he uncovers a deadly plot aimed at dividing India on religious lines, he must use his combat skills and intelligence to protect his country. With high-octane stunts, intense chase sequences, and a patriotic theme, the film keeps audiences on edge. Directed by Aditya Datt, it’s the third installment in the Commando series.

programme.desc: CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is a first-of-its-kind free, 24-hour channel in the U.S.dedicated exclusively to global soccer coverage. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK, with its unparalleled coverage of all the top domestic and international soccer competitions across the globe, is the ultimate year-round streaming destination for soccer fans. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is anchored weekdays from 7:00-9:00 AM, ET, by - MORNING FOOTY, the Network’s flagship morning show. Every weekday, MORNING FOOTY host Susannah Collins along with former U.S. Men’s National Team player Charlie Davies, analyst Nico Cantor and comedian Alexis Guerreros bring their unique voices and fresh perspectives to the latest news and storylines impacting soccer worldwide. As soccer’s new staple show for fans everywhere, MORNING FOOTY delivers a daily dose of razor-sharp insights and laughs with match highlights, compelling analysis, entertaining interviews, updates - from reporter Jenny Chiu and more that is sure to help kick off your day. In addition, the Network will feature live matches, pre- and post-match breakdowns, magazine shows, films from Paramount+’s STORIES FROM THE BEAUTIFUL GAME soccer documentary collection and original programming. The Network’s live matches and re-airs utilize CBS Sports’ collection of top-tier soccer properties, including UEFA club competitions, Serie A, NWSL, Concacaf national team competitions, Barclays Women’s Super League, Campeonato Brasileirão Série A, Scottish Professional Football League, Argentina Liga Profesional de Fútbol and the AFC Champions League, among others. Watch CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK 24 hours a day, 7 days a week and all 365 days a year.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: How do you top the already in many ways superior iconic Porsche 911? - You come up with the GT3. - The Porsche 911 GT3 with its 475 hp engine is the ultimate melange of road suitability and race track compatibility. And the German brand's RS model is even more intense when it comes to power, performance and ultimate sports car feel.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: What has been known in motorsports for ages is now used for road vehicles as well: lightweight construction. In many cases the magic word is carbon. The German manufacturer Roding created a car that even outshined the Porsche GT3 with an impressive power/weight ratio. British makes like the Caterham 620 R, Lotus Elise or Radical RXC also showed what's in play in regards to lightweight sports cars.

programme.title: BMW M6 Gran Coupe
programme.desc: The M6 Gran Coupe is the latest creation from BMW's M-works subdivision. The Bavarians show that driving this V8 powered car almost feels like flying, even with the whole family on board.

programme.title: Porsche Cayman GT4
programme.desc: The Porsche Cayman GT4. Lighter, more powerful and faster than ever. Porsche shows what is possible with this vehicle, when fast lap times are in the focus of attention.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: British coupes are instant classics and just as cool as James Bond. Aston Martin, Bentley and Jaguar produce the most exclusive and elegant coupes in the world. Their distinctive design is still inspired by the iconic Jaguar E-Type and Aston Martin DB5.

programme.title: Maserati Gran Turismo Coupe Stradale
programme.desc: Risk-taking and precision is what a poker player needs to have. What does this have to do with the Maserati Gran Turismo Coupe Stradale? It combines both characteristics in an amazing way.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: With their avantgarde design, superior technology and driving pleasure, German coupes like the Porsche 911, the Mercedes S-Class Coupe, the BMW 6-series or the Audi RS5 embody the passion for driving.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: They are the embodiment of a sportscar, the coupes by Ferrari, Lamborghini, Maserati and Alfa Romeo are breathtaking and irrisistible. Created by the most famous designers in the world, every Italian sportscar is a piece of art.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: With their extraordinary design and powerful engines, international coupes by Maserati, Porsche, Bentley, Mercedes and Rolls Royce evoke more emotions than any other car. They are the epitome of elegance and exclusivity.

programme.title: Volvo Laplander 6x6
programme.desc: More extremes are always possible. Volvo's Laplander army vehicle has 6 wheels, 3 axles and provides space for at least 12 soldiers.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: In 1964, Ferruccio Lamborghini set himself the goal to build the best sports cars in the world, a bold move, being located only a few kilometers from Ferrari.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: After the Second World War, following in his father's footsteps who had been responsible for the development of the classic Volkswagen, Ferry Porsche laid the foundation for the brand's sports car models like the 356 and later the Porsche 911.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: One cannot talk about rally sports without mentioning the name Walter Röhrl. From an early age, Röhrl showed his talent in rally sports and won the European, World and other international rally championships several times in his career.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: Hans-Joachim Stuck is one of the best racing drivers in Germany. Over his long career he not only won the Formula II and several international touring car championships multiple times but also the famous 24-hour race of Le Mans twice.

programme.title: Ford GT40
programme.desc: With their V8 cars, Ford showed that they were able to build race winners. The Ford GT40 was a prime example for that, especially in Le Mans.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: In this episode we invite you to witness the progress of driver Uwe Nittle as he got ready for qualifying at the Truck Grand Prix.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: The RCN Challenge is the ultimate BMW driving experience. We also paid a visit to the Devils Diner, the track's indoor meeting place for drivers.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: After the 24-hour race was over we left the Nürburgring and moved to Büren, Germany, where the Raeder Motorsport company is based. They are famous for front-wheel drives with a great performance that put a lot of horsepower to the track.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: The roaring sounds of engines and exhausts usually dominate the Nürburgring, but we focused on something a bit quieter this time. How about taking part in a 15 mile bike ride around the ring, or perhaps a 16 mile run?

programme.title: Artega GT
programme.desc: From 2006 to 2012 the German company Artega produced their GT sports car model. Thanks to the know-how of a former Porsche and BMW manager the Artega GT was able to be manufactured in a small series.

programme.title: 4x4

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: SUVs usually are rather impressive right out of the factory, but there are many tuning and customizing options. In this episode we present Kelleners BMW X5, the Mercedes Brabus B63 and the Porsche Cayenne tuned by Techart.

programme.desc: When the Audi A1 becomes the S1 and the Golf gets an R in its name, these small cars turn into all-wheel beasts. Also: the Mini Countryman gets a rejuvenation. And: a test drive with the best-selling Volvo XC60.

programme.title: Isle of Man - Tourist Trophy, Part 1
programme.desc: Tourist Trophy on the Isle of Man. The abbreviation "TT" could also stand for death and the devil. Every year the most dangerous motorcycle race in the world takes place. One lap in the Tourist Trophy is 61 kilometers long. 260 curves require everything from the riders. It's a unique myth.

programme.title: Isle of Man - Tourist Trophy, Part 2
programme.desc: The most dangerous motorcycle race in the world on the Isle of Man. Marshals at the TT are responsible for the highest possible levels of safety.

programme.desc: After the shoot of the second season of this series, the stunt team created 13 little action movie sequences on their own that are sometimes funny, sometimes gritty, sometimes a bit mad, but always spectacular.

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.sub-title: Inside Pro Surfing: Western Australia Margaret River Pro 2025
programme.desc: The Western Australia Margaret River Pro is the 7th stop on the 2025 World Surf League Championship Tour, running from May 17 to May 27. This crucial event marks the mid-season decider, where the world's best surfers put it all on the line to advance through the next section of the tour. It is also the third and final stop of the GWM Aussie Treble. Margaret River will bring the action with pumping waves and strong competition.

programme.title: The Vault
programme.desc: 2003 was an epic year for the FIJI PRO. Andy Irons took down Cory Lopez in an epic battle to win the event. Andy was ripping the entire contest and put the world on watch that he was coming for his second world title. - Andy and Cory: It happens a lot on tour, friends who travel and stay together end up in the same heat surfing against each other. Sometimes ‘friendship' stays on the beach and other times they go out and see who can get the best waves and have a fun surf. Andy got on a roll on the Final day of the contest, throwing down 9's and 10's through the Quarter, Semi and Final. He had a perfect 10 and backup 9 point rides before good mate Cory had even put a score on the board. There were three perfect 10 point scores handed out during this Quiksilver Pro Fiji and Andy scored them all. It was Andy at his best in a year when he won 5 out of the 12 CT events and a second World Title.

programme.title: Brilliant Corners
programme.sub-title: Wolves' Weddings | Brilliant Corners: Algeria, Episode 2
programme.desc: Sam, Lucy, and Erwan head to the naturally beautiful Kabyle region along with locals Dihya Nasri and Walid Assef. Once there, they surf some clean, cold, and completely uncrowded peelers and get some famous ice cream in Béjaïa, a market city known for its rich music scene, vibrant clothing, and incredible views of the Sapphire Coast. They then explore the stunning Cap Carbon headlands and learn about the native Berber culture and ancient Kabyle language.

programme.title: Dead Meat
programme.desc: Scott Leysath is targeting saltwater and freshwater fish in this action-packed episode of Dead Meat! Joined by a few familiar faces, Leysath is fishing for California Halibut off the coast of Santa Cruz with his pal, Kevin Phillips. From Santa Cruz to Reno, Scott meets up with River Klass, host of the Rach America TV show, for a little range time at Reno Guns & Range. And finally, the two join JD Richey, a 2024 California Outdoor Hall of Fame fishing guide, on Pyramid Lake for some Lahontan Cutthroat Trout action. Oh, and there's machine guns. Lots of machine guns!

programme.title: Feral
programme.desc: If you asked experts what the most prevalent predator species in the United States is, without hesitation, the answer would be the Burmese pythons in the Florida Everglades. Growing up to 26-feet long and weighing as much as 200 pounds, the Burmese python has completely altered the ecosystem of the Everglades by eliminating over 99% of the native mammal population. To save the 'Glades, the hunter has become the hunted as Dusty ""Wildman"" Crum has made it his mission to eradicate this species. Luckily for Yia, python is considered a delicacy in many countries, and Dusty believes these constrictors should be restricted to life on a plate, which helps take a bite out of the problem.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.sub-title: Time is Not On Their Side
programme.desc: For Dale and Matt sometimes the dotted line to treasure splits and heads in opposite directions. In this edition of What’s in the Barn, time is thrust to the forefront of this multi-state, long distance, north, south search. Timeless and priceless 110 year old bikes, antique cars, airplanes, and the infamous Egberts 1930 neon Harley-Davidson sign that coined the phrase “Ride a Winner” are high on this father and son’s list of “must haves”. The clock ticks, both literally and figuratively, on one rare time piece and two old-timer’s cars, bikes, and automobiles.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Promoters of the prestigious Amelia Island Concours have called on Dale to develop a show and field bikes for an “Orphan Bike” show. They have defined orphan bike as extremely rare, that aren't a Harley nor Indian machines.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Home Depot Senior Vice President, Gordon Erickson, is a huge fan of Wheels Through Time. He is also a huge supporter of the Wounded Warrior program. For years the hardware giant has been donating goods and services to help returning servicemen with their fix-it-up projects. Now they would like to go one step further and build a WWII military bike to raise awareness and funds. Only problem is where to get one? Enter Dale and an exhaustive, time sensitive, cross country search for a rare military machine.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: The RM Auction Company has worked with Dale before as a buyer, seller, historian, and caretaker at the prestigious Lee Hartung auction. But this event is no last minute rush to define one man’s treasures. This is a well calculated, time consuming, multi-media, and multi motorcycle and prized art deal.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Big Time Motorcycle Auction

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Built in the mid-60’s by eccentric engineer “Wild Bill” Gelbke, the Road Dog was, and still is, the largest motorcycle ever built. It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Matt is out for revenge. Last year Dale beat him badly at the Annual Vintage bike race in Barber, Alabama. But this year there is a whole new tale to tell. With just days until the race - Dale is secretly struggling to get the bike he beat Matt with last year up and working. Matt struggles just to locate a 100-year old bike. Matt's prayers are answered thanks to an old Catholic Priest he located who has possession of a bike. The priest might let Matt have the bike to race - but there are conditions. The toughest one: Don't tell Dale you have it. Can Matt afford to buy the bike and get it running in time for the race without Dale seeing it? Will Dale even get his broken bike started? And if they ever get to race, will Matt exact his revenge?

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: An family farm in the mid-west contains houses, barns, outbuildings, trailers, grain silos and buses full of old stuff and perhaps the biggest stash of undiscovered old motorcycles in the country. The collection was put together by their unnamed father. Seller agrees to have Dale broker rare Excelsior for high-end client. Dale has the buyer, but will he outbid his own client for the exclusive find?

Urban-planning solutions are urgently needed to prevent Tokyo from choking on its own growth. Strategies include raising density, promoting shared housing and micro-homes, and investing in ‘urban villages’, neighborhoods where people can live, work and spend their leisure time.

The adventures in Moscow are diverse: An awkward visit to a Russian bath, a wild night out in an exhilarating dance club and a chance to drive a cold-war military tank. Next, they fly to Siberia and meet a vodka-slamming shaman, who puts them all to shame on the dance floor.

programme.title: Going Beyond
programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

programme.title: Our Dominicana
programme.desc: Put away the parasol & lace up your shoes to join proud islander, Judith Rodriguez Perez, on a journey discovering the vibrant heart of the Dominican Republic. Venture beyond the beaches and see the island as the locals do. Dive into Our Dominicana.

programme.title: The World Is Yours
programme.desc: This time in "The World is Yours" will take you to a very peculiar island: Madagascar! There we will spend time in the company of the strangest creations of Nature. Caverns, beaches, reefs and exuberant forests where the most exotic fauna and flora of the planet coexist, will be the destination of this wonderful journey in which you will be received by its friendly inhabitants and their zest for life! Now, if what you are looking for is to share with friends and feel like at home, nothing like New Orleans' southern hospitality. Get ready because the food and the music are not the only charms of this moving city. History, customs and colorful festivals await you in the streets of this picturesque place. This tour ends with a trip to the past, to the age of castles and cathedrals at Edinburg! Where youll feel as the star of stories of knights in armor, you will listen to the stories of the soldiers who participated in the siege of the castle and visit the Cathedral of St. Egidio to enjoy its architecture with original stained-glass windows of the XXIV century its really worth knowing!

programme.title: Trails and Trailblazers
programme.sub-title: Catskills Adventure, Upper Peninsula of Michigan
programme.desc: Ariel meets up with astronaut John Herrington and they explore colorful Colorado.

programme.title: Dream of Italy
programme.desc: In Chianti, we celebrate true Chianti at Castello di Ama, and at Busatti in Anghiari, 100-year-old looms craft fine fabrics. We will also hunt wild boar and meet butcher Dario Cecchini in Panzano, and ride with the butteri in Maremma.

programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.desc: The county of Soleto was founded in 1055: the Norman Robert Guiscard of Hauteville conquered the rusty lands of Southern Salento and entrusted Earl Orsini with them. Soleto can now boast the only remaining legacy of the region's Norman age: the 'Guglia di Raimondello' the striking bell tower which is considered one of the finest examples of Apulian gothic style.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 94: Un Beso de Despedida Inesperado
programme.desc: Mar a Gracia insiste en que se vayan a comer, Luis Fernando un poco confundido le dice si es verdad que ellos hab an acordado ir a comer ese d a y la muchacha lo confirma. A Dileidi no le queda de otra que bromear con Aureliano quien la ayuda a salir del momento tan incomodo, luego ella le pregunta por que hizo eso y el le dice que como es su pana el ayuda a sus panas pero que no fue por otra cosa no eso no. Pascuita tambi n tiene una situaci n incomoda en su casa, Gladis rompi el vaso, ella esta rabiosa por lo que le acaba de decir Gonzalo y encima tiene que disimular su rabia, Gladis es la que se cuenta de todo como siempre, pero Gonzalo se fue con cierta duda por la actitud de Pascuita. Matilde esta llena de gozo, no puede creer a n que este trabajando y al lado de Ram n menos, el que no esta tan bien es R mulo quien aprovecha el momento para seguir con su encuesta con respecto a la vida ntima de Eglee, en esta oportunidad le toca a Ram n, quien al igual que los dem s le dice lo mismo, que si puede ser, que no puede ser, que, que le pueden decir, total que el pobre R mulo queda igual, cuanto mas pregunta mas confundido esta. Otra que esta al borde la locura es la Nena que anda metida en tremendo paquete con Aristigueta y no sabe como hacer para que Doroteo no se entere, se desahoga con Rosita, a quien todo eso le parece divertid simo, la Nena le pregunta si ya lo del divorcio esta caminado y de nuevo ella le dice que no, que ahora est n en poca navide a y por lo tanto los tribunales no trabajan que eso ser muy dif cil, ya la Nena esta que revienta y Rosa le dice que para que se va a divorciar si ella esta saliendo con Doroteo, pero la Nena insiste. Mientras Theo conversa con R mulo le dice que tienen que darle una fecha para el concierto, R mulo que esta en la luna como siempre, le dice que el no sabe nada de eso, y Theo le recuerda que ellos no le pueden echar la partida par atr s, pues de ese toque depende su econom a, R mulo no le para mucho y aprovecha para encuestar a Theo sobre si Eglee tiene cara de estar con otra persona, Theo le contesta lo mismo que los anteriores que si, que no, que puede ser, total que R mulo cuanto mas pregunta mas se estresa. Ya R mulo esta a punto de perder el control cuando ve a Eglee le molesta hasta que se r a, pues cree que esa risa tiene algo que ver con Santiago, le hace reproches mentalmente, ella se extra a un poco por la actitud de su ex, el que ya no aguanta se pone como un energ meno, cada vez que ve a Santiago cerca de Eglee la hierve la sangre y no puede mantener el control, le pide a su mujer o sea a Betzaida que se vayan, pero como le habla en un mal tono, ella ni le para, Luis Fernando lo ve tan mal que le pregunta que le pasa, y como en ese momento ve a Santiago solo dice que el tiene ganas de matar a alguien, Luis Fernando no entiende nada Santiago se hace el loco. Luis Fernando y Aureliano se lanzan cada vez que pueden, pero ahora le toco al arquitecto le dice que si su novia no le dijo del proyecto que tienen el y Dileidi, Aureliano que esta claro de lo que pasa entiende que le puede contar ella si lo que esta es enamorada del flaco ese. Las cosas entre Remedios y Gladis ya casi se salen tambi n lo normal, se saludan con cierta molestia, Gabito se da cuenta que las mujeres se quieren agarrar pero el le aclara a Gladis delante de Remedios que ella es a quien el verdaderamente quiere, pero Gladis no cree nada, por que si es as que hace Remedios a n all . A Gonzalo le molesta la alegr a de su mujer, cree que tiene la casa y a el abandonados por el trabajo, ella le dice que no es as , y el le echa en cara que Monchito quiere tener algo con ella, que por eso es que la propuso para el proyecto, no por que ella es una profesional sino para tenerla cerca de el, ella lo niega todo. Pascuita espera que su marido le cuente la novedad de que Matilde esta en la oficina trabajando con el, pero Ram n se hace el tonto, hasta que pascuita explota y el tiene que reconocer que si pero que eso no tiene tanta importancia, ella le dice que no esta celosa, que Matilde es muy cosa como mujer para que ella pueda llegar a celarlo a el con ella, pero la procesi n va por dentro. En casa de Eglee el combo espera por Luis Fernando, mientras el esta a n en la oficina tratando de concentrarse en algo, luego compiten en encestar papeles en la papelera y por supuesto que gana Dileidi, Marco Aurelio pr cticamente los corre, les aclara que el no paga horas extras, cuando se van el jefe aconseja a Luis Fernando, le dice que no deje escapar a Dileidi. Una afuera en la calle el le ofrece llevarla a su verdadera casa y ella acepta, por el camino recuerdan los momentos de cuando eran novios, ella le confiesa que si desde el principio le hubiese dicho que ella viv a en Petare el seguro que no se hab a fijado en ella, el lo niega, le dice que en el ba o ella le habr a podido pedir lo que quisiera y el la hubiera complacido, cuando al fin llegan al barrio donde de verdad ella vive, el se ofrece a llevarla hasta su casa pero ella le dice que el con esa pinta de seguro que lo roban que mejor ella se va sola para su casa, pero al momento de despedirse no saben como lo har n pues ellos nunca se despidieron bes ndose en la mejilla, pero como ahora las cosas son diferentes ella se le acerca para despedirse y se quedan los dos mir ndose fijamente.

programme.title: Un Milagro en Texas
programme.desc: Un Milagro en Texas es una comedia desternillante que se desarrolla en el corazón de la Gran Depresión. John Ratzenberger y Kevin Sorbo brillan interpretando a dos astutos estafadores que urden un plan para conquistar a viudas y convencerlas de invertir en sus aparentemente inútiles empresas de pozos de petróleo. Las risas no se hacen esperar mientras las viudas luchan con sus decisiones, solo para que la situación se invierta cuando un giro inesperado del destino conduce a un auténtico hallazgo de petróleo.

programme.title: La Cacería: Las Niñas de Alto Hospicio
programme.sub-title: La Caceria: Las Ninas de Alto Hospicio - 72 Hours
programme.desc: El capitán Rojas llega al norte de Chile desde Santiago para investigar la misteriosa desaparición de un grupo de adolescentes en Alto Hospicio. Carrasco, un oficial de policía local asignado como su compañero, intenta explicarle la teoría oficial: las jóvenes huyeron de sus vidas infernales para prostituirse en el extranjero. La investigación de Rojas, combinada con la desaparición de la hija de un pescador local, revela una verdad más perturbadora. Rojas está convencido de que las chicas fueron secuestradas o asesinadas.

programme.title: La Cacería: Las Niñas de Alto Hospicio
programme.sub-title: La Caceria: Las Ninas de Alto Hospicio - Tacna
programme.desc: Información de inteligencia confirmada por el jefe de la policía de Alto Hospicio obliga a Rojas y Carrasco a viajar a Tacna, una ciudad peruana salvaje en la frontera con Chile. En Perú, Rojas se infiltra en las bandas de trata de personas que comercian con “esclavas blancas” en un intento por encontrar a las chicas chilenas desaparecidas, sin éxito. Después de que Carrasco lo rescata de una muerte segura en un club en Perú, regresa a Chile con una nueva teoría: hay un asesino en serie en Alto Hospicio.

programme.title: La Cacería: Las Niñas de Alto Hospicio
programme.sub-title: La Caceria: Las Ninas de Alto Hospicio - La Primera Victima
programme.desc: Tras revisar todos los asesinatos de mujeres en la zona, el capitán Rojas cree haber encontrado el "caso cero" de su asesino en serie: una prostituta cuyo cuerpo apareció en una playa hace dos años. Mientras Rojas sigue esta pista, Carrasco sospecha de un profesor de voleibol que enseñó a varias de las chicas desaparecidas. La información se difunde entre los vecinos, que quieren hacer justicia por su cuenta.

programme.title: La Cacería: Las Niñas de Alto Hospicio
programme.sub-title: La Caceria: Las Ninas de Alto Hospicio - Los Perros
programme.desc: Rojas sale del hospital tras recibir una brutal paliza en la que Carrasco también participó en secreto. El intento de intimidarlo solo refuerza su necesidad de seguir investigando, pero su teoría se desmorona cuando se prueba la inocencia del conductor de La Ponderosa, a quien consideraba el principal sospechoso. Paralelamente, Andrea investiga el pasado de Rojas y una amenaza contra su hijo Diego lleva al capitán al límite.

programme.title: La Cacería: Las Niñas de Alto Hospicio
programme.sub-title: La Caceria: Las Ninas de Alto Hospicio - Todas las Familias
programme.desc: Después de exponer la corrupción y amenazar a su superior, Rojas continúa su investigación sin el apoyo de la policía. Una nueva pista lo lleva a investigar un secreto dentro de la familia Ávila. Andrea gana la confianza de la hermana de Valeria Ávila, cuyo testimonio los acerca a la verdadera identidad del asesino. Ayleen intenta reencauzar su vida, sin saber el peligro que eso conlleva, ya que el psicópata de Alto Hospicio busca una nueva víctima.

programme.title: La Cacería: Las Niñas de Alto Hospicio
programme.sub-title: La Caceria: Las Ninas de Alto Hospicio - El Pozo
programme.desc: Rojas está convencido de haber descubierto la identidad del psicópata, pero no tiene pruebas. Viaja al pueblo natal del asesino, donde descubre el origen de sus instintos violentos. Ayleen sobrevive a un brutal ataque y su testimonio se convierte en la clave para encontrar al psicópata. Rojas y Carrasco deben unir fuerzas nuevamente para quebrar al asesino y obtener la confesión que necesitan. Finalmente, Rojas se enfrenta cara a cara con el psicópata de Alto Hospicio.

programme.title: Grannies on Safari
programme.sub-title: Montevideo: Uruguay - City of the Drums

programme.title: Grannies on Safari

programme.sub-title: Cooking on the Sea of Cortez

programme.title: Mexico One Plate at a Time with Rick Bayless
programme.desc: Join Rick and winemaker Hugo d'Acosta as they toast the world-class wines of Baja California Norte. Hugo first introduces Rick his Casa de Piedra wines before moving on to Tres Mujeres, L.A. Cetto, and the San Rafael Winery.

programme.title: Mexico One Plate at a Time with Rick Bayless

programme.title: Wild Life

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: While on pursuit with Scratch and Grounder, Sonic and Tails hide in an underground mine which a miser mole think that they are trespassers.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic saves a female hedgehog from Scratch and Grounder which Sonic falls in love with, while Dr. Robotnik plans to flood a village by stealing the water from the Mobius reservoir.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic must save a family of sloths from Dr. Robotnik's slow-motion ray, but when he himself is slowed down by Scratch and Grounder, Tails and the sloth family must take action.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Desperate to get workers to build a Robotnik statue, Dr. Robotnik opens Casino Night Zone with his pal Smiley but when Sonic stops Scratch and Grounder, Robotnik traps Tails so Sonic has to make a choice to save his pal.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch, Grounder and Coconuts set up a chili-dog trap which then resulted with Tails been captured by a mysterious person so Sonic has to find Tails and for Robotnik and co to capture Sonic.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Dracula in Love
programme.desc: Leila, a lonely young soul spends the night partying with her friends Nancy, David and Nash in a warehouse. As the boys drink up and smoke pot all social barriers between the sexes crumble. Leila, hit on by both men, hides away from them. Alone she senses there is someone else who wants her and certainly he is not of this world. A 200 year old Dracula escapes from a crate and reveals himself to Leila and tells her that she is his lost love. For him to live again and be with her, she must bring him the blood of her friends to drink and make love to him. Hypnotized by his sexual powers, Leila does as she is told. Leila and a handsome young Dracula get away and live happily ever after.

programme.title: Rancho Esperanza
programme.desc: Una joven lo tiene todo: un hermoso rancho, un caballo llamado Faith y el amor de su familia. Pero tras la muerte de su padre, un militar, ella y su madre corren el riesgo de perder también el rancho familiar. Con un poco de ayuda de sus amigos y de su majestuoso caballo blanco, urden un plan para reunir el dinero suficiente para salvar el rancho mientras aprenden a no perder nunca la esperanza, a pesar de todo.

programme.title: Entrenando A Tu Esposo
programme.desc: Jillian es una exitosa terapeuta matrimonial y autora de libros de autoayuda sobre el matrimonio. Como su relación no va muy bien, intenta arreglar su propio matrimonio enfocándose en cómo cambiar a su esposo.

programme.title: La Bella Y La Bestia
programme.desc: Eric Landry es un hombre de corazón frío al que la gente ha apodado "la Bestia". Años de ira y amargura lo han consumido, convirtiéndolo en un hombre egoísta. Pero Belle Watson es exactamente lo contrario. Ella es cariñosa y amable. Trabaja duro para ayudar a su familia, a menudo sacrificando sus propias necesidades y deseos para satisfacer las necesidades de los demás. Cuando su padre rompe accidentalmente una valiosa obra de arte en la mansión Landry, Bella se ve inmersa en la vida de la Bestia. Haciendo todo lo posible por no dejarse intimidar por su mezquindad, Belles acepta trabajar para Eric en un esfuerzo por pagarle y salvar el trabajo de su padre. Ella descubre que podría haber más en Eric. ¿Encontrará al hombre dentro de la Bestia?

programme.title: Un Amor que no Tiene Precio
programme.desc: Tras darse cuenta de que uno de los artículos de su tienda de segunda mano es una valiosa tetera antigua valiosa, Rose se encuentra en el punto de mira de un ambicioso corredor de antigüedades. Él está decidido, pero ella se niega a vender hasta que pueda encontrar al propietario original.

programme.title: Buscando al Dr. Amor
programme.desc: Jenny, peluquera recién divorciada, se propone reconectar con Liam, su amor de la universidad, y se sorprende al enterarse de que él es el "Dr. Amor", el DJ que ella escucha en la radio. Mientras la relación de la pareja se reaviva poco a poco, Jenny descubre que Liam ya está prometido. ¿Se romperá el corazón de Jenny por segunda vez o prevalecerá el amor verdadero?

programme.title: Fuera Del Menu

Mason recurre a Curt en busca de consejo sobre su padre, justo cuando su relación con él llega a un nuevo punto crítico. Un empleado descontento revela la vulnerabilidad de Mason y el peligro en el que la propia Jess se encuentra.

programme.title: El Sabor Del Amor
programme.desc: Una joven y talentosa sous chef en el mejor restaurante de la ciudad de Nueva York recibe una invitación para servir como jueza en un concurso de comida en Kansas, donde se vuelve a conectar con su novio de la universidad.

programme.title: Capitán Apache
programme.desc: Un oficial del ejército de los EE.UU. nacido en América del Norte, el capitán Apache, investigando un asesinato, descubre un complot de asesinato presidencial.

programme.title: Guerrero cheyenne
programme.desc: En su viaje hacia Oregón, Matthew y Rebecca se detienen en un puesto fronterizo donde un malentendido con los Cheyenne desencadena una tragedia. Rebecca y un guerrero herido, Hawk, son los únicos supervivientes. Con el invierno acercándose, ambos deberán superar sus diferencias para sobrevivir.

programme.title: Reverendo Colt
programme.desc: El reverendo Miller llega a Tucson donde quiere construir una iglesia, pero el mismo día de su llegada, una banda lleva a cabo una redada en el banco y la gente de Tucson, que sospechan del nuevo reverendo porque lleva un arma, le culpan inmediatamente del robo.

programme.title: Plazo para morir
programme.desc: Una historia sobre dos pistoleros, Duke y Steve. Steve está enamorado de la hija de Duke, pero Duke desaprueba la unión, imaginando una vida de penurias y peligro para la chica si se casa con Steve.

programme.title: La caravana de Oregón
programme.desc: Dos caravanas de carros convergen en lo que ahora es Kansas City, y se combinan para el empuje hacia el oeste de Oregón. En su búsqueda, los peregrinos experimentarán el calor del desierto, la nieve de las montañas, el hambre y los ataques de los indios.

programme.title: La leyenda del Llanero Solitario
programme.desc: El único Ranger de Texas (Klinton Spilsbury) superviviente de una emboscada organizada por el líder de los forajidos, el Mayor Bartholomew "Butch" Cavendish (Christopher Lloyd), vuelve para contraatacar como un gran héroe del western enmascarado, El Llanero Solitario.

programme.title: Relevo para un pistolero
programme.desc: Un desconocido de Boston ofrece a un notorio ex forajido de Arizona un trabajo que no puede rechazar.

programme.title: Rita En El West
programme.desc: La pequeña Rita tiene un sueño: sueña con un mundo mejor y cree que todo el mal del mundo se origina en el oro.

programme.title: Reza al muerto, mata al vivo

programme.title: Más allá de la ley
programme.desc: Un trío de ladrones conspira para robar el cargamento de plata de un pueblo, pero un giro de los acontecimientos los convierte en los héroes del pueblo.

programme.title: Texas, 1870

programme.title: Alambradas de violencia

programme.title: La muerte no cuenta los dólares

programme.title: Requiescant, descanse en paz

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Andrei se casa con Natasha, quien está feliz, ya que siempre ha estado enamorada de él. Mientras tanto, el negocio de Maks enfrenta problemas, pues un poderoso mafioso llamado *El Amo* le exige pagar sus deudas. Para salvar el negocio de su esposo, Anna se convierte en amante de *El Amo*. Andrei recibe la visita de su amigo Vadim, quien está en Moscú investigando a Udalov por tráfico de niños. Juntos, deciden atraparlo. Anna y Andrei se reencuentran y sus sentimientos renacen, pero Natasha queda embarazada y Andrei no se atreve a abandonarla. Después de discutir con Andrei, Anna toma un taxi, pero los pasajeros, unos adolescentes drogadictos, intentan abusar de ella. En la lucha, uno de ellos muere.

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Maks se divorcia de Anna y, aprovechando su detención, la deja sin nada. Andrei intercede ante un alto funcionario (el padre del joven fallecido) para evitar que el caso de Anna avance, ya que ella es inocente. Anna es liberada. Vadim invita a Andrei a Moscú, donde abren una agencia de detectives. Natasha apoya la decisión de su esposo y lo acompaña, pero su matrimonio se deteriora, ya que Andrei no puede olvidar a Anna. En la estación de tren, Anna salva a un hombre de un intento de asesinato: es Udalov. *El Amo* había enviado a un sicario para matarlo por no compartir sus ganancias en el tráfico de niños.

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Anna Koroleva es la primera belleza de la ciudad. Hace tiempo que se ha acostumbrado a la idea de que todo el mundo se interesa sólo por su aspecto. Está rodeada de flores y admiradores, muchos pretendientes. El bandido local Zhukov tampoco pudo resistirse a ella, pero Anna se mantiene inaccesible: no le gusta Zhukov. Contrata a unos matones para que den una lección de venganza a la terca belleza. Un transeúnte, Andrei Savin, es testigo del ataque y defiende a la chica. Inesperadamente, Anna se enamora de Andrei. Al enterarse de la aventura de Anna, Zhukov se enfurece. Al descubrir que su antigua amante está embarazada, le dice a Andrei que el bebé es supuestamente suyo, de Zhukov. Andrei intenta averiguar la verdad, pero Anna, ofendida por su desconfianza, declara que efectivamente está embarazada del bandido. Andrei la deja, Anna aborta. Si hubiera podido adivinar a dónde la llevaría su orgullo...

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Zhukov le dice a Andrei que el hijo de Anna es suyo. Andrei cree el rumor, lo que provoca que Anna termine la relación y aborte. Udalov asesina a Gushin, pero antes de morir, este logra decirle a Andrei el nombre de su asesino. Anna, al ver a Andrei consolando a Natasha, la hija de Gushin, piensa que él ya no la ama y, en un acto de desesperación, intenta suicidarse. Su mejor amiga, Masha, la lleva al hospital. En venganza contra Andrei, Anna acepta casarse con Maks, el médico que le salvó la vida. Mientras tanto, Udalov establece en Rusia un negocio de adopciones ilegales de niños extranjeros, con la ayuda de la directora del hospital materno-infantil, María Serguéievna.

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Andrei se casa con Natasha, quien está feliz, ya que siempre ha estado enamorada de él. Mientras tanto, el negocio de Maks enfrenta problemas, pues un poderoso mafioso llamado *El Amo* le exige pagar sus deudas.
